START_HERE_NEXT_CHAT.md:
# Continue PHARM D WITH HYZEN 1.4.2+10

Read docs/COMPACT_READER_1_4_2.md first. This supersedes the old floating Sections
drawer with the owner's Home/Study/PDF/Shop/Settings dock. It also replaces the
default Google scanning Activity with a durable page-by-page system-camera flow,
fixes external content-intent routing and compact reader/home/workspace layout.

Read docs/PDF_STUDIO_1_4_1.md for the new scanner, OCR, structured document
writer, AES export, lossless page operations and layered annotation exports.

This is the existing Flutter app com.hyzen.pharmd, with the original signing
identity retained in private GitHub Actions secrets. Never generate a new key.

Read docs/DRIVE_PIPELINE_1_4.md first. Native Drive/PDFium delivery, secure Google
authorization, byte-range reading and resumable private downloads are implemented.
IMPORTANT: the current Google Cloud project still needs Drive API and Android
OAuth client configuration. Until configured, Drive files automatically use the
original online preview and public downloads. Disabled/blocked API errors also
fall back; permission errors still require access. Native saved-file reading
remains available. No owner Google Cloud settings have been changed.
Do not claim live Drive delivery or a successful speed improvement until the
configured API actually returns document bytes.

The updated UI uses a floating bottom dock with a nested Study popover.
Root Home never shows a dead back arrow. Reader
controls include zoom, page navigation and text search; Studio viewer actions
are consolidated under Edit, bookmark and a three-dot menu.
Profile promotions use real shop data, phone validation recovers after edits,
and profile save has a visible confirmation. Technical sign-in error codes and
the student/admin helper sentence have been removed.

Check the latest release workflow and test output for validation evidence.
qa/drive_benchmark_results.json records network measurements, not first rendered
page timing. The same-phone visual benchmark remains blocked by API setup.

Merge/split/page organization preserve original PDF page content. Only explicit
flattened export rasterizes. Scanning, on-device Latin OCR, AES-128 PDF protection
and standard editable annotations are implemented. Rich creation supports basic
formatted blocks; arbitrary Word layout editing and exact PDF-to-Word conversion
are not implemented. Camera scanning still needs physical-device acceptance.

README.md:
# PHARM D WITH HYZEN

Flutter Android app, com.hyzen.pharmd, source version 1.4.2+10.
Read docs/COMPACT_READER_1_4_2.md first for new changes and validation status.
Use Flutter 3.35.4 / Dart 3.9.2 and JDK 17.

PDF Studio includes Create PDF / native document scanning, on-device Latin OCR,
lossless page operations, editable PDF annotations, AES password and compression
exports, and a structured PDF/DOCX writer. Read docs/PDF_STUDIO_1_4_1.md for
scope and physical-device requirements. Drive cloud setup remains pending;
original online preview and public offline downloads now work as fallback routes.

This update restores the owner's five-item floating reference dock with a nested
Study menu, a compact PDF workspace and durable camera/gallery page drafts. It
also improves compact layouts, removes duplicate downloads artwork, simplifies
login errors, fixes mobile-number error recovery and confirms profile saves.
Profile includes a swipeable promotion carousel driven by the existing catalog.
PDF reader supports text search, previous/next match, page controls and zoom.
The Studio top bar has Edit, bookmark and overflow tools.

Read **docs/DRIVE_PIPELINE_1_4.md** before testing live Drive files. The native
Drive API/PDFium pipeline needs owner Google Cloud API/OAuth setup. The existing
Firebase key is restricted from DriveFiles.Get and no Android OAuth client is
configured in the original Google services file. Missing/disabled API setup
automatically selects the original Google online preview. Public downloads use
Google's download/export endpoints, including bounded large-file confirmation;
Google still enforces file permissions and download restrictions. Native API
reading remains the preferred configured route, with an Online preview action
if the reader fails. This app contains no service
account credentials or OAuth client secrets. The Google connection is optional
for local files and separate from email/password app login.

Native offline transfers stream to app storage, show progress, retain paused
partials and resume when validators and HTTP Range permit. A PDF is finalized
only after type/end-marker/length checks. Deletion only affects local copies.

The project retains all existing backend URLs and existing owner signing
identity. Release signing secrets are excluded from this archive and restored
only in the owner's private GitHub build. Do not replace the key.

Build:
    flutter pub get
    dart format lib test
    dart fix --apply
    flutter analyze --no-pub
    flutter test --no-pub
    flutter build apk --release

Actual live Google speed comparison, signed-in backend acceptance and physical
phone gesture testing require the owner's configured accounts/devices.
PDF Studio page manipulation preserves text/vectors; flattening is explicit.
See docs/PDF_STUDIO_1_4_1.md for implemented tools and remaining format limits.
docs/COMPACT_READER_1_4_2.md:
# PHARM D WITH HYZEN 1.4.2+10

Build destination Horizon003/pharm-d-with-hyzen was explicitly authorized by the
owner. The original private CI signing identity is unchanged. Check the release
workflow for Flutter and Android regression results; local structural checks
alone are not a compilation or a camera-hardware test.

This revision follows the owner's compact purple Home / PDF Workspace reference.
The opaque floating dock has Home, Study, a prominent PDF center, Shop, Settings.
Study opens a dismissible nested menu (Notes > Regular / Special, MCQs, PPS,
Downloads). Profile remains in the top-right header. PDF reader screens hide the
main dock and use a single compact page/search/create/zoom/tools dock.

Greeting artwork remains beside the text on narrow phones; very large accessible
text hides decorative artwork rather than stacking another large panel. Headers,
resource rows, recent study entries and subject tiles use compact typography and
spacing. Text scaling is not globally disabled. Sections and real data remain.

Android content intents are owned solely by HyzenExternalFiles. Flutter's default
deep-link handler is disabled to prevent content:// URIs becoming unknown app
routes. Read-only device previews do not require app sign-in. The history id is
retained in the reader URL so the route is not dependent solely on route extras.
Settings and Shop now belong to the authenticated shell and Android back returns
to Home instead of exiting a directly selected top-level destination.

## Lightweight multi-page camera and gallery flow

Create PDF asks Camera or Gallery. Camera delegates one full-size capture to the
installed Android camera application using a narrowly scoped FileProvider grant.
Each confirmed photo appends to a private on-device draft. Add more captures,
rotate, reorder or remove pages, name the PDF and save. Gallery photos join the
same flow. A pending camera path and page list are committed before handing off
to the camera. Process recreation recovers them without a live Dart callback.
Images are EXIF-corrected and bounded to control memory. Camera UI differs by
device; this flow does not provide automatic document-edge cropping.

The old heavy Google scanner bridge remains in the source but is not the default
camera flow. Its physical-device crash could not be proven from screenshots
alone; the replacement removes that dependency from normal capture. Real camera
device acceptance is still required; mocked capture tests are not hardware tests.

Save validates the produced page count, commits Studio history, then clears only
the app-owned draft. Failed saves retain pages for retry. Originals are untouched.
Existing source Drive links, public fallback and original signing identity remain.
Drive API/OAuth configuration is still not completed. No source migration or
Google Cloud permission changes are part of this release.

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';

import 'tokens.dart';

class AppTheme {
  AppTheme._();
  static const fontFamily = 'Manrope';

  static TextTheme _text(Color ink, Color ink2) {
    const f = fontFamily;
    return TextTheme(
      displaySmall: TextStyle(
        fontFamily: f,
        fontSize: 28,
        height: 1.15,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
        color: ink,
        letterSpacing: -0.6,
      ),
      headlineMedium: TextStyle(
        fontFamily: f,
        fontSize: 23,
        height: 1.2,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
        color: ink,
        letterSpacing: -0.4,
      ),
      headlineSmall: TextStyle(
        fontFamily: f,
        fontSize: 20,
        height: 1.25,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
        color: ink,
        letterSpacing: -0.2,
      ),
      titleLarge: TextStyle(
        fontFamily: f,
        fontSize: 16,
        height: 1.3,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
        color: ink,
      ),
      titleMedium: TextStyle(
        fontFamily: f,
        fontSize: 14,
        height: 1.35,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
        color: ink,
      ),
      titleSmall: TextStyle(
        fontFamily: f,
        fontSize: 14,
        height: 1.35,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
        color: ink,
      ),
      bodyLarge: TextStyle(
        fontFamily: f,
        fontSize: 14,
        height: 1.45,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
        color: ink,
      ),
      bodyMedium: TextStyle(
        fontFamily: f,
        fontSize: 13,
        height: 1.4,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
        color: ink2,
      ),
      bodySmall: TextStyle(
        fontFamily: f,
        fontSize: 11.5,
        height: 1.45,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
        color: ink2,
      ),
      labelLarge: TextStyle(
        fontFamily: f,
        fontSize: 13,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
        color: ink,
        letterSpacing: 0.1,
      ),
      labelMedium: TextStyle(
        fontFamily: f,
        fontSize: 13,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
        color: ink2,
      ),
      labelSmall: TextStyle(
        fontFamily: f,
        fontSize: 11.5,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
        color: ink2,
        letterSpacing: 0.6,
      ),
    );
  }

  static ThemeData light([Color seed = HColors.primary]) =>
      _build(Brightness.light, seed);
  static ThemeData dark([Color seed = HColors.primary]) =>
      _build(Brightness.dark, seed);

  static ThemeData _build(Brightness b, Color seed) {
    final dark = b == Brightness.dark;
    final ink = dark ? HColors.darkInk : HColors.ink;
    final ink2 = dark ? HColors.darkInk2 : HColors.ink2;
    final bg = dark ? HColors.darkBackground : HColors.background;
    final surface = dark ? HColors.darkSurface : HColors.surface;
    final scheme = ColorScheme.fromSeed(seedColor: seed, brightness: b)
        .copyWith(
          primary: dark
              ? ColorScheme.fromSeed(seedColor: seed, brightness: b).primary
              : seed,
          onPrimary: dark ? const Color(0xFF25133F) : Colors.white,
          surface: surface,
          onSurface: ink,
          onSurfaceVariant: ink2,
          error: HColors.error,
          outline: dark ? const Color(0x33FFFFFF) : HColors.outlineStrong,
          outlineVariant: dark ? const Color(0x1FFFFFFF) : HColors.outline,
        );
    final text = _text(ink, ink2);
    final border = OutlineInputBorder(
      borderRadius: HRadius.all(HRadius.md),
      borderSide: BorderSide(color: scheme.outlineVariant),
    );
    return ThemeData(
      useMaterial3: true,
      brightness: b,
      colorScheme: scheme,
      fontFamily: fontFamily,
      scaffoldBackgroundColor: bg,
      textTheme: text,
      splashFactory: InkRipple.splashFactory,
      appBarTheme: AppBarTheme(
        backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
        surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
        elevation: 0,
        scrolledUnderElevation: 0,
        centerTitle: false,
        foregroundColor: ink,
        titleTextStyle: text.titleLarge,
        systemOverlayStyle: dark
            ? SystemUiOverlayStyle.light
            : SystemUiOverlayStyle.dark,
      ),
      cardTheme: CardThemeData(
        color: surface,
        elevation: 0,
        margin: EdgeInsets.zero,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: HRadius.all(HRadius.lg),
          side: BorderSide(color: scheme.outlineVariant),
        ),
      ),
      inputDecorationTheme: InputDecorationTheme(
        filled: true,
        fillColor: dark ? HColors.darkSurfaceAlt : Colors.white,
        contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
          horizontal: 16,
          vertical: 16,
        ),
        border: border,
        enabledBorder: border,
        focusedBorder: border.copyWith(
          borderSide: BorderSide(color: scheme.primary, width: 1.6),
        ),
        errorBorder: border.copyWith(
          borderSide: const BorderSide(color: HColors.error),
        ),
        focusedErrorBorder: border.copyWith(
          borderSide: const BorderSide(color: HColors.error, width: 1.6),
        ),
        labelStyle: text.bodyMedium,
        floatingLabelStyle: text.labelMedium?.copyWith(color: scheme.primary),
        hintStyle: text.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
          color: dark ? HColors.darkInk2 : HColors.ink3,
        ),
        errorStyle: text.bodySmall?.copyWith(
          color: HColors.error,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
        ),
        prefixIconColor: ink2,
        suffixIconColor: ink2,
      ),
      filledButtonTheme: FilledButtonThemeData(
        style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
          minimumSize: const Size(0, 46),
          textStyle: text.labelLarge,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: HRadius.all(HRadius.md)),
        ),
      ),
      outlinedButtonTheme: OutlinedButtonThemeData(
        style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
          minimumSize: const Size(0, 46),
          foregroundColor: ink,
          textStyle: text.labelLarge,
          side: BorderSide(color: scheme.outline),
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: HRadius.all(HRadius.md)),
        ),
      ),
      textButtonTheme: TextButtonThemeData(
        style: TextButton.styleFrom(
          minimumSize: const Size(48, 44),
          textStyle: text.labelLarge?.copyWith(fontSize: 14),
        ),
      ),
      chipTheme: ChipThemeData(
        selectedColor: dark ? const Color(0xFF4D2D73) : HColors.primarySoft,
        checkmarkColor: dark ? const Color(0xFFD8BFFF) : HColors.primary,
        labelStyle: text.labelMedium,
        side: BorderSide.none,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: HRadius.all(HRadius.pill)),
      ),
      navigationBarTheme: NavigationBarThemeData(
        labelTextStyle: WidgetStateProperty.resolveWith(
          (s) => text.labelSmall!.copyWith(
            color: s.contains(WidgetState.selected) ? scheme.primary : ink2,
            fontWeight: s.contains(WidgetState.selected)
                ? FontWeight.w800
                : FontWeight.w500,
          ),
        ),
        iconTheme: WidgetStateProperty.resolveWith(
          (s) => IconThemeData(
            size: 27,
            color: s.contains(WidgetState.selected) ? scheme.primary : ink2,
          ),
        ),
      ),
      dividerTheme: DividerThemeData(color: scheme.outlineVariant, space: 1),
      iconButtonTheme: IconButtonThemeData(
        style: IconButton.styleFrom(
          backgroundColor: dark
              ? HColors.darkSurfaceAlt
              : const Color(0xFFF7F5FA),
          foregroundColor: ink2,
          minimumSize: const Size(42, 42),
          shape: const CircleBorder(),
        ),
      ),
      bottomSheetTheme: BottomSheetThemeData(
        backgroundColor: surface,
        surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
        showDragHandle: true,
        shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(HRadius.xl)),
        ),
      ),
      dialogTheme: DialogThemeData(
        backgroundColor: surface,
        surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: HRadius.all(HRadius.xl)),

      snackBarTheme: SnackBarThemeData(
